title: nt65 project
description: nt65.json: what a program is built from, and how. `nt65 build` reads it from the directory it runs in or the nearest one above it.

$schema.description: The schema this file is validated against. nt65 accepts it and reads nothing from it.

cpu.description: The processor the program is built for. A `.cpu` item in a file must agree with it.

files.description: Globs naming the program's sources, from the project root. Order is not significant, and a glob may reach above the root, so a library shared between projects is part of each.

out.description: Where the output goes; the project root when there is none. A module's output is named after it, so `.module gfx::sprite` is written to `out/gfx/sprite.s` wherever its source is.

defines.description: The build configuration: constants visible in every file, and the only symbols an `.if` condition may test. A name with a module's path, "hw::SOUND", sets that module's `.config` instead.

segments.description: The segments the program uses, with the address size each is reached at. A segment declared here may not also be declared in a file.

ranges.description: Which banks an absolute constant address in each range may be reached from, for hardware registers mirrored in some banks only. A key is one address or a range of them, and no two keys may overlap.

configurations.description: Named builds of the program, chosen with `--config name`. A name is letters, digits, `_` and `-`; with none chosen the project's own settings build.

number.description: A number: a JSON number, or a string in nt65's number syntax, "$2100" or "%1010".

banks.description: Banks, each one bank or a range of them: 1, "$7e" or "$00-$3f".

size.description: How wide an address in the segment is: "zp" for the direct page, "abs" for two bytes, "far" for three.

dp.description: The direct-page register the segment is reached through, for a `zp` segment on the 65816.

bank.description: The bank the segment sits in, on the 65816.

mirrors.description: The other banks the segment appears in, written as `ranges` writes banks. A segment with mirrors needs a bank.

defines.description: Defines over the project's, by name.

out.description: Where this configuration's output goes, in place of the project's `out`.
